findings.fix: Capture q4 selection once before the first callback-capable clock/diagnostic and use that local selector throughout the call. Revalidate the selected descriptor version/kind and _missing_policy_version late, preserving the original negative roster. Apply equivalent care to q4 entry selection; do not widen old branches.
findings.problem: Q4 selection is repeatedly read from mutable _missing_policy_version. After snapshot/roster validation, a diagnostic callback can set it to 3 (and optionally change the live descriptor), bypassing the q4 late stability check. A completion callback can therefore also change a cache object without the required refusal. Earlier changes can select the legacy union path after starting a q4 guard.
findings.proof_needed: Completion-counter callback simultaneously downgrades selector and swaps cache; require exact first-error identity, closure and permanent poison. Also downgrade from early guard diagnostic; no legacy fallback may run.

findings.fix: For q4, validate canonical shapes/names after first reconciliation BEFORE alias cache lookups, and immediately before each cls.recheck after intervening callback-capable work. Retain original seal/reconciliation order and capture first export return only once. Never call unsupported receiver/key hooks merely to discover their invalidity.
findings.problem: Shape validation is not immediately before all newly protected callback boundaries. First reconciliation can replace sys.modules or insert unsupported keys, then alias sys.modules.get executes BEFORE snapshot validation. Source seal callbacks can similarly change dependency maps before first cls.recheck. Before second reconciliation, _guard_step(bindings) may mutate maps, and cls.recheck reaches its live loaded-map/sys.modules lookups before the late validator.
findings.proof_needed: Use exact dicts with armed str-subclass collision keys, and unsupported map receivers introduced by first reconciliation or diagnostic step; refusal must precede hook execution, then preserve close/poison. Include early diagnostic mutation, not just already-invalid entry state.

findings.fix: Keep a strong stdlib baseline reference in the per-call snapshot and require both current pointers still match it during late comparison. Preserve initial exact-string validation and the lifetime-baseline intent.
findings.problem: The returned snapshot holds map/set receivers strongly but omits the stdlib baseline reference. A late callback can replace BOTH sys.stdlib_module_names and owner._stdlib_names with a new exact frozenset. _q4_snapshot compares those two mutated pointers and _q4_stable has no captured baseline to compare, so this observed baseline replacement can pass.
findings.proof_needed: Completion callback changes both baseline pointers to a distinct equal-content frozenset, then to widened contents; both must refuse even with unchanged cache/maps.

limits: Static prospective implementation review only. Root-reported test counts are not independently validated here. No timing, installed payload, native, controls, actual10 or runtime qualification evidence. Async ABA/post-final-observation mutation remain stated sampling limits. Review corrected diff separately before GO.
test_review: Inspected authored q4 guard tests and existing fixture/entry paths only. Tests require body-enter/completed markers and exact first failure/closure/poison; they do not count descriptor refusal as runtime success. No tests or jobs were run by this review.
verified_design_properties: _q4_copy checks exact container types before len/iteration and exact str names before hashing into copies. Copied dictionary values are strong references and late map values compare by identity, avoiding value equality hooks.

Cache and allowance ceilings are checked before aggregate snapshot construction; duplicate entries across allowance inputs and two fixed exclusions count toward 65536. Receiver references, copied cache/loaded values and allowance contents are retained locally.

Whitelist scan uses captured cache and eligibility contents, not rebuilding a union per key. Unknown names still refuse. Second export return is retained and compared by validated contents; return-set object identity need not match.

Late comparison is after _guard_end and _guard_complete, with another real deadline check. New errors remain inside original _fail/re-raise/finally path. Source/custody/image/process/environment predicates remain present.

Qualifier captures version and expected CPU versions before dependency initializers; explicit q4 uses four imports, result-v2 and qualification_version4. Q1-q3 retain original whitelist loop and selector meanings; historical semantic tests are still required.
